description: This file defines debugging and logging components for the FreeType project, including macros, enums, and function prototypes related to debugging, tracing, and error handling.

methods.name: FT_Message
methods.description: Prints a formatted debug message to stderr.

methods.name: FT_Panic
methods.description: Prints a formatted error message and exits.

methods.name: FT_Throw
methods.description: Reports an error with file and line information.
